trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 15-20 degrees; the depression is sharply defined against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe (image right) exhibits several high-amplitude jagged excisions and valleys, while the left lobe shows more uniform, lower-amplitude micro-peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Consistent convex curve from the central notch towards the distal tips, with a pronounced upward-curving orientation at the lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of high-intensity white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the outer tips and trailing edges of both lobes; several isolated white circular pixel points are visible across the dark central dorsal field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy encrustation of acorn-type barnacles along the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme contrast between the dark uniform dorsal pigmentation and the white, multi-layered texture of parasitic barnacle growth at the fluke tips.
